annotations.title: List short links and click counts

description: List tracked short links (/l/<code>) for posts and Instagram DMs along with human click counts for the last 7, 30 or 90 days, previous-period comparison, and all-time totals (Studio and Pro). No cookies or visitor data are kept. Changes nothing.

autoreplyRuleId.description: Filter to short links attached to one Instagram auto-reply rule id.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: Click window to sum, counted back from today: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

draftId.description: Filter to short links attached to one draft id from drafts_list.

postId.description: Filter to short links attached to one published postId.

name: short_links_list
title: List short links and click counts
